thread:
Elena R: Heads up—EdgeForge reported duplicate SKU keys in last night's batch. entitlements are skewed for a handful of accounts. Anyone on call for reconciliation?

Aj Patel: saw the alert, digging into batch logs now. suspecting the batch window overlapped due to clock skew on their side.

marketplace-bot: webhook delivery failure to https://marketplace.edgeforge.com/hooks at 02:14 UTC — 429 rate limit. retry scheduled in 120s.

Sanjay: if it's duplicate SKU lines, we should de-dupe by (partner_event_id + sku) using idempotency key. we already have a replay endpoint /metering/replay that accepts idempotency_id.

Elena R: good call. Aj, can you pull the sample events and share 3 examples in thread?

Aj Patel: pasted sample below:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_20241113_0001","partner_id":"edgeforge","sku":"EDGE-XL-1","units":120,"timestamp":"2024-11-13T01:03:12Z"}
{"event_id":"evt_20241113_0001","partner_id":"edgeforge","sku":"EDGE-XL-1","units":120,"timestamp":"2024-11-13T01:03:13Z"}
{"event_id":"evt_20241113_0025","partner_id":"edgeforge","sku":"EDGE-XL-2","units":60,"timestamp":"2024-11-13T01:05:00Z"}
```

Marta (partner-eng): confirming—those duplicate event_ids came from our collector retry logic when the ack didn't return in time. we can do a replay with unique idempotency hints if you want.

Sanjay: plan proposal:
- 1) run de-dupe job on ingestion window (remove exact duplicate event_id+sku)
- 2) run entitlement recalculation for affected accounts (delta apply)
- 3) if replay needed, partner to send trimmed replay with idempotency_id header
- 4) update partner contract: require event_id uniqueness and optionally seqno

Elena R: timeline?

Aj Patel: can run de-dupe job today, ~30m. recalcs will be a few hours depending on affected rows. I will coordinate a pause on billing cutover until done.

Marta (partner-eng): we'll generate replay payload by EOD and set idempotency_id = replay_run_20241113_1. Also we'll rotate webhook backoff to exponential to avoid 429s.

Elena R: add runbook note — I'll file a short postmortem and update the marketplace integration doc. thanks all :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: tagging @sre for watch during replay.

marketplace-bot: replay endpoint accepted 3/3 events (idempotency hint present).
